name: MS MARCO (Microsoft MAchine Reading COmprehension)
description: A large-scale dataset of real user queries and web documents, with human-generated answers and relevance judgments for machine reading comprehension and passage-ranking research.
citation: Nguyen, T., Rosenberg, M., Song, X., Gao, J., Tiwary, S., Majumder, R., & Deng, L. (2016). MS MARCO: A Human Generated MAchine Reading COmprehension Dataset. Proceedings of the Workshop on Cognitive Computation: Integrating neural and symbolic approaches, 1–6. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/W16-2601

license.notes: The upstream project does not specify a standard SPDX license identifier for the dataset. Review Microsoft's applicable dataset terms and rights in the underlying web content before use or redistribution.
